integrationNotes: sdbkit has no cymbal file; do not silently label another kit cymbal as sdbkit.
x0xproc2 has one generic cymbal, not separately labelled crash and ride.
Every kit includes separate high, mid and low tom files; filename labels do not assert concert MIDI pitches.
Preserve source hashes and document any downmix, bit-depth conversion, resampling, trimming or gain changes in a derived bank.
Numerical QC is not a listening or sound-quality approval.
Sample mean over a finite percussive clip is not by itself proof of an audible DC offset defect.
